decision_question: Given the files touched and a description of the change, can this change plausibly affect a user-visible or agent-observable flow (e.g. browser behavior), such that agent-tool verification (beyond deterministic checks like lint/tests) should be performed before treating the change as verified?
output_format: Return exactly one of the allowed output values, optionally followed by a one-line rationale.
forbidden_information: whether any verification was actually performed or what it found
evaluation_notes: The corpus splits this decision type into two partitions that must never be pooled: 'deterministic_prefilter_validation' (obvious cases meant to validate a frozen deterministic file-path rule, not a model) and 'system1_judgment' (genuinely ambiguous cases, the only ones meant to be posed to a Claude/Laya system-1 judgment call). The partition label itself is corpus-internal bookkeeping and must never appear in or be derivable from the rendered prompt.
